items.risk: Acquisition integration and monetization of the broader optimization layer remain execution-dependent.
Large-system deployment timing and customer concentration can make quarterly revenue and margins uneven.
Customer concentration can overwhelm otherwise attractive structural automation demand if the dominant customer slows deployments.
A deployment pause, repricing or strategic change by the dominant customer could materially impair revenue, receivables and operating leverage.
Internal-control remediation remains necessary; future undetected misstatement risk cannot be dismissed.
Competing warehouse automation stacks can pressure pricing and customer diversification.
Backlog remains highly concentrated in Walmart and Exol, so deployment timing, acceptance and contract changes at those relationships can materially affect realization.
Large contracted backlog can mask timing and customer concentration risk if deployments or acceptance milestones slip.
